I'm thrilled to announce that Primordial Empire will be in Tokyo Game Show 2025![/p][p][/p][p]From [b]September 25-28[/b], the Primordial Empire demo will be on display with the new Wildlife Update at the Slug Disco booth[b], Hall 11-E32[/b] in the indie games area of [b]Makuhari Messe[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]I'll be there too so if you are also attending the event, come and say hi! 🙂[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/f32e732081298ddc39d62ae357b22cbfa462db21.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Wildlife Update!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p][b]The Wildlife Update is here![/b] Introducing neutral wildlife to Primordial Empire, this update features 9 new species of microbes and plants, and a brand new mechanic that allows more meaningful interactions than simply fighting them. Here are the update highlights:[/p][p][/p][h2]Wildlife[/h2][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/710415f28e22beacac72ef000139c19a38ddf2fa.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/7da13c029f1e515980f42c936c2cd7a4d5a911f6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/cac91a4d8a3caeb1dc737036fc4cee567bb49712.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/468355b64c40dff5e91605c58428127e9e1bf921.png"][/img][/carousel][p]You can now find neutral wildlife scattered across the maps, sometimes forming a basic food chain or delicate ecosystems in various pockets. These new creatures possess their own unique abilities and habits:[/p][list][*][p]Cave Grass: Micro Agave in darkness have been replaced with Cave Grass (same mechanics but with a distinct look).[/p][/*][*][p]Witherleek: A wild plant native to fungal biomes, producing poisonous food particles.[/p][/*][*][p]Progenitor Cells/Pods: Ancestral wild forms of Stem Cells, often at the base of the food chain.[/p][/*][*][p]Wild Hunter Cells/Pods: Predators that prey on local wildlife such as Progenitors.[/p][/*][*][p]Nomad Cells & Egg Clutches: Scavenger-predators forming migratory routes between nests, often spanning great distances.[/p][/*][*][p]Conjugator Cells/Pods: Exist in two types, A and B, which only reproduce when paired. How odd.[/p][/*][*][p]Wild Glowplant: Native to the Cave biome, these plants can generate light.[/p][/*][*][p]Uglets: Replacing Stabpoles as the spawn of the Big Ugly (identical stats).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Symbiosis[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/928595dbc637561b87407f3616ff1ed42f642bbc.png"][/img][/p][p]The neutral creatures are not always your competitors – they can be allies too! Incorporate them into your colony with the new befriending mechanic. Utilize their unique abilities and expand your microscopic empire with all the diverse life forms.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Biomes[/h2][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/bbada58a33f204b53dd4ca73c5ac0a5a4b19213a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/69d0225ae8f71161e33dc540d85abe488e5d8657.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/54da83aeb1014b99abb35c038e7304c7cf742f3c.png"][/img][/carousel][p]Biomes now have more distinct features that separate them from one another, including native wildlife and environmental modifiers. Play the bonus scenario to explore them all, now unlockable by completing the economic and combat scenarios at any rating![/p][p][/p][p]These new creatures have been in the works since the combat update so I'm very excited to finally add them to the demo. And of course, this update contains a myriad of optimizations and fixes, which can be found in the changelog at the end of this post.[/p][p]If you would like more insights to the new creatures and biomes, I'll be posting a couple guide videos on the [url="https://www.youtube.com/@PrimordialEmpire"]Primordial Empire YouTube channel[/url], so don't forget to check out the channel and subscribe to get the latest news of my game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/4f481b9a6e47ac4f1ae4ae5ec530fefc82a7538a.png"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][h3]Full Changelog:[/h3][olist][*][p][b]Wildlife:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cave Grass: Micro Agave in darkness have been replaced with Cave Grass (same mechanics but with a distinct look).[/p][/*][*][p]Witherleek: A wild plant native to fungal biomes, producing poisonous food particles.[/p][/*][*][p]Progenitor Cells/Pods: Ancestral wild forms of Stem Cells, often at the base of the food chain.[/p][/*][*][p]Wild Hunter Cells/Pods: Predators that prey on local wildlife such as Progenitors.[/p][/*][*][p]Nomad Cells & Egg Clutches: Scavenger-predators forming migratory routes between nests, often spanning great distances.[/p][/*][*][p]Conjugator Cells/Pods: Exist in two types, A and B, which only reproduce when paired. How odd.[/p][/*][*][p]Wild Glowplant: Native to the Cave biome, these plants can generate light.[/p][/*][*][p]Uglets: Replacing Stabpoles as the spawn of the Big Ugly (identical stats).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Symbiosis[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Many neutral organisms can now be approached peacefully via the “Befriend” action. Invest resources to gain wildlife-specific bonuses (requires Neurons/Complexity to “understand” them).[/p][/*][*][p]Example bonuses:[/p][list][*][p]Free Stem Cell production (from Progenitor Pod),[/p][/*][*][p]Poisoned food becomes edible (from Witherleek),[/p][/*][*][p]Predators (Feeder Cells & Carnivorous Protein Factory) can hunt neutrals & enemies (from Wild Hunter),[/p][/*][*][p]Light sources activated in caves (from Wild Glowplant),[/p][/*][*][p]…and more,[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added Empathic Ganglion, a new growable plant (under "Development") that halves the Complexity cost of befriending neutrals,[/p][/*][*][p]Fighters (Lancet Cells, Hydras) received a configuration toggle to allow/ban automatic attacks on neutral wildlife. Shift-clicking toggles across all fighters,[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tutorial:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Tutorial 7 to introduce the befriending feature. Note: Depending on UI scale settings, you may need to scroll the tutorial list a bit for it to show,[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Biomes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Biomes are now more distinct, featuring their own native wildlife and environmental modifiers (e.g., no natural light in caves). This will be most noticeable in the bonus scenario,[/p][/*][*][p]Bonus scenario now unlocked after beating the economic and combat scenarios at any star rating to make the wildlife and biome inclusions more accessible.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes & QoL:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Background rendering overhaul (parallax-ready) - adds dynamic blur to the background layer depending on zoom level,[/p][/*][*][p]Added Steam screenshot support (F12),[/p][/*][*][p]Build tool configurations (e.g., enabled/disabled production chains) now save & load with scenarios,[/p][/*][*][p]Hunting configurations (e.g., allow/ban hunting Stem Cells) can now be shift-clicked to apply across all organisms of the same type, making colony-wide behavior toggles much faster,[/p][/*][*][p]ESC now correctly reverts to normal cursor mode,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where pressing Ctrl to show movement paths also highlighted enemy movement paths,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where keyboard shortcuts (e.g. to replant remains) worked from within pause menu,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash when spamming R to rebuild multiple remains,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Carnivorous Protein Factories and Feeder Hubs rebuilt from remains not remembering hunting preferences.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash caused by the pathfinding system[/p][/*][*][p]Added second toggle to fighters to allow/ban attacking friendlies,[/p][/*][*][p]ProcGen avoids toxic patches during resource generation,[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial 7 now remembers GUI element introduction steps after loading,[/p][/*][*][p]Added health indicator to friendly and own organisms' hover info panel (lower left corner)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist]

notes.title: August Monthly Round-Up 🦠
notes.content: [p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Time really does fly by when you’re trying to build an empire in the deep sea – we’re already in September! I’ve been working on an upcoming update aiming to introduce wildlife to Primordial Empire, and some of you might have seen some snippets in last month’s round-up. This monthly post will ressemble more of a dev log -- we'll go through some of the work-in-progress with a bit more detail and a few more screenshots. [/p][p] [/p][h2]Wildlife Incoming[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/6066344b977b4df7eff3b49b9d2c3625e65bc2f8.png"][/img][/p][p]You might have already seen the above life forms last month, and here's a different shot of these “wildlife” components coming in the future. The yellow cells are progenitor cells (spawned by the yellow plant on the left), which are basically “wild stem cells” that work like the player-controlled ones. They eat and then they split, serving as the foundation of certain wildlife interactions (e.g. there will also be predators). They are generally harmless, but if they get into your feeding grounds, they may cause an "infestation" and eat away at any food for your own cells. When you see them, keep an eye on their numbers! I wonder if there's a way to make use of them...[/p][p][/p][h2]Long Distance Wanderers [/h2][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/75fe63b1fad34c4bc2d9f2da2b125763da9ea1e6.png"][/img][/carousel][p]This little guy is a Nomad Cell - you will encounter them in the Salt Barrens biome. As an adaptation to the harsh arid landscape they are native to, they form migratory pathways between their spawn hubs, potentially across vast distances. They are opportunistic omnivores that eat both cells and food particles, and can endure long journeys without food. It’s a single-cell organism with fin structures and a calcified endocytosis site (or “beak”), and the “eye” is actually the cell nucleus with endoplasmic reticulum around it. The sponge-like structure at the bottom is a filtration system they can use to absorb thinly distributed nutrients, allowing them to last longer even if they don't find any solid food. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/a84fc3f1d89974080bf58de8247bb589bfd8a3be.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]A Dance Among Crystals[/h2][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/5d76ba2522bf9bc37da2d34f82a56e6a8069f3b3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/15b1cfa74e9adac614a1e5f483adfe7df0c367d1.png"][/img][/carousel][p]And finally, introducing the Conjugator Cells, the latest creature I’m working on. Native to the mineralized biome, they come in two flavors: Conjugator A (red) and Conjugator B (blue). Like most other life in Primordial Empire, the mobile cells spawn out of sessile buds. But unlike other cellular life, these guys have discovered a peculiar way of reproduction: they mate! Conjugator A cells will seek out Conjugator B cells, and if they “click”, they do a little "dance" upon which some genetic material from A gets transferred to B, fertilizing them. Fertilized B cells will then search for a new place to settle, where they will transform into a new bud. Fun fact: Fertilized B cells can sparkle![/p][p][/p][h2]Back to School[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/9ed282a12d4cf3f466d602e7040c1fb37c93e10e.png"][/img][/p][p]Before we go, just want to quickly mention that Primordial Empire is in the Back to School Games Celebration. You can find a massive collection of fun and educational titles ranging from scientific knowledge to language and mathematical skills, and of course, Primordial Empire is here to get you ready for biology. Check out the event [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44695353/sale/BacktoSchoolGamesCelebration2025"]here[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]I hope you like these new creatures that are coming in the next update. If you want to know more about them, join us on Discord! I'll be posting development updates regularly, and feel free to ask any questions you have about the the creatures, gameplay or anything else you can think of. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Follow our socials![/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/kanwBTWBZ5" style="button"]Discord[/url]    [url="https://www.youtube.com/@PrimordialEmpire" style="button"]YouTube[/url][/p][h3][/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: July Monthly Round-Up 🦠
notes.content: [p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Welcome back to our monthly blog post! Last month’s combat update introduced two new scenarios to Primordial Empire, one of which a procedurally generated secret level that plays differently every time. It’s been great seeing everyone enjoying the new challenges so much, and I cannot thank you all enough for playing the demo and showing so much enthusiastic support for my game. Now I am more excited than ever to share you some of the new content that I've been making for the next update.[/p][p] [/p][h2]What’s Next[/h2][p]After introducing combat and warfare to this microscopic colony builder, my focus shifted back on developing new content – for example, new plants! Here’s a sneak peek at what I’m currently working on:[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/c17986d2d4e6e3aaad0501e237eacbb76c72c8da.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/4c3b3aea56e5e2c5bf46e1ec441a2fcc6bd78091.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/c1d97ca7f6e27e01d4f32e74f9cb75b80fd656d4.png"][/img][/carousel][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/e06b57ef1f9e818f917ea4a344adc5ad2fc88768.png"][/img][/p][p]These will be part of a wildlife update for the Demo to further flesh out different biomes by adding native wildlife. They will generally be neutral towards the player while adding flavour and potentially strategic spins to the scenarios with various ways to interact with them. I've delved deeper into this upcoming mechanic on my [url="https://discord.gg/kanwBTWBZ5"]Discord[/url] so feel free to join our discussion there.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Demo Patches[/h2][p]Aside from new content in the works, I’ve also implemented several changes in Primordial Empire earlier this month to further polish the existing content in the demo. Here’s the full changelog of v0.2.7_demo and the follow-up patches.[/p][p][/p][h3]v0.2.7_demo Patch Notes[/h3][list][*][p]Fatal combat damage to ally plants now produces remains that can be double-clicked to replant,[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Neuronal Complexity calculation: "longest chain bonus" is now "largest interconnected cluster bonus" (much more efficient and reliable calculation, and gives a slightly larger bonus),[/p][/*][*][p]Further optimized plant placement tool,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crash when recycling prioritization pheromone,[/p][/*][/list][h3]Hotfix (2025-07-09):[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed potential crashes when loading between different maps,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "blind spots" in neuron cluster calculation,[/p][/*][/list][h3]Amendment (2025-07-10):[/h3][list][*][p]Added hotkey \[R] and info-panel button for convenient re-planting of remains[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][/p][p]What's your guess on the new content? What kind of micro-organisms do you think they are and what do they do? Join us on Discord or comment on the Steam discussion forum to share your best guess! Please look forward to our next update, and be sure to follow our socials to get the latest news from Primordial Empire.[/p][p][/p][p]Follow us on:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/kanwBTWBZ5" style="button"]Discord[/url]    [url="https://www.youtube.com/@PrimordialEmpire" style="button"]YouTube[/url][/p][h3][/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: June Monthly Round-Up 🦠
notes.content: [p][b]Greetings everyone! [/b][/p][p][/p][p]This month has seen some big changes to Primordial Empire’s demo, with our first bit of combat content finally arriving, and more updates followed to refine this microscopic warfare. Let us quickly go through what happened in June! [/p][p][/p][h2]Combat Update[/h2][previewyoutube="Aszt4TtvNKY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Thanks to all of your support, the combat update has been met with enthusiastic response from the community! The new combat scenario has introduced ruthless enemies and brutal battles to Primordial Empire. See the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3450780/view/501701175839557650?l=english"]patch notes[/url] for the full details![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/7c6dbbccf04328c44d646fbf81ffa321f1389500.png"][/img][/p][p]And there's even more to the update -- if you achieve 3 stars in both the economic and combat scenarios, you can unlock a third, bonus stage with a procedurally generated map that makes every replay a unique experience. You will need to carefully plan your expansion and explore truly unknown territories while fending off waves of enemies from multiple angles. Master the first two scenarios and take on the new challenges of the bonus scenario![/p][p][/p][h2]Follow-Up Patches[/h2][p]Getting the new content online is just the first step. I’ve been working on refining the microbe combat experience with balance changes, fixes and optimizations throughout June. Some of these changes include:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/9571c5ad4841f151d8b0ac0bd4e894847bbe79c4.png"][/img][i]Introducing Biome modifiers to the Bonus Scenario that add more variety to the environment – different biomes have different characteristics[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/6cd9419771c134e0941088026b5f7fe0e4e8969b.png"][/img][i]You can now manually save your progress, with up to 48 slots available![/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/837792487e7b732c8bc7c2119936caef8fff93ec.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Improved exploration and path-finding to help you traverse the map with more ease.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Full details of the updates can also be found at the bottom of this blog post.[/p][p][/p][p]June has been a hectic month with the barrage of updates, and all the work has been worth it to see everyone enjoying the combat stage so much. Thank you so much for playing Primordial Empire’s demo, and your consistent feedback has been some much appreciated (and very essential) nutrition for the game to continuously evolve. It's time for me to start working on the next batch of update, so please look forward to more new content in the future![/p][p][/p][p]Follow us on:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/kanwBTWBZ5" style="button"]Discord[/url]    [url="https://www.youtube.com/@PrimordialEmpire" style="button"]YouTube[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]June Update Full Patch Notes:[/h2][h3]v0.2.2_demo patch notes:[/h3][list][*][p]Change to Stem Cell plasma production: They now continually produce Plasma (even when starving),[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed plasma balance indication mismatch at higher biomass (please notify if still inaccurate),[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced biome modifiers to Bonus Scenario: Lush Biome: More fertile ground in light, lots of wild growth, rich in protein Salt Barrens Biome: Less fertile ground, sparse wild growth, rich in resources Mineralized Biome: Very rich in minerals Fungal Biome: Toxin-rich, relatively low in minerals Cave Biome: More fertile ground in darkness,[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced Bonus Scenario procedural generation:[/p][list][*][p]Fairer enemy placement,[/p][/*][*][p]Fairer resource placement,[/p][/*][*][p]Increased incursion warning lead time to 3:00 minutes (up from 1:00),[/p][/*][*][p]More sensible enemy incursion points,[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Hotfix:[/h3][list][*][p]Prevents game crashing during final wave in Bonus Scenario,[/p][/*][*][p]Prevents rare crash during main menu after having selected Bonus Scenario and switching to a different scenario,[/p][/*][/list][h3]v0.2.3_demo patch notes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed Bonus Scenario stars not getting counted in main menu,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rare main menu crash when selecting Bonus Scenario and then immediately loading another scenario,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed plasma balance indicator inaccuracy (second attempt),[/p][/*][/list][h3]v0.2.4_demo patch notes:[/h3][list][*][p]Improved exploration & path-finding:[/p][list][*][p]Attractive pheromone now needs line-of-sight with Vesicle Hubs only if sending cells to unexplored territory - sending them around where vision is available no longer requires Vesicle Hubs around,[/p][/*][*][p]Cells can now pathfind across the entire map (enemies, too),[/p][/*][*][p]Convenient waypoint mode: holding shift, just click start- and endpoints and the best path is automatically calculated,[/p][/*][*][p]Changed attractive pheromone range to 80% of original in waypoint mode, 160% of original in normal (simple click) mode,[/p][/*][*][p]Cells attracted to a waypoint pheromone will hook into it from the waypoint closest to them.,[/p][list][*][p]Recycle tool can now remove attractive pheromones (normal- and waypoint pheromones). Cells attracted by removed pheromone abandon their movement plan.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed heat death zone in Economic Scenario to make achieving the 3-star goal less tedious,[/p][/*][*][p]Lancet Hives now start with two Lancet Cell production chain inputs filled (up from one),[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]v0.2.5_demo patch notes:[/h3][list][*][p]Rebalanced Bonus Scenario for fairer starts:[/p][list][*][p]Enemies spawn farther from Colony Heart,[/p][/*][*][p]More crystal patches within reasonable range of Colony Heart,[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed Nematoblast's and Aminoberries' position not updating after maturing if parent Plant shrinks/grows,[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized plant placement tool,[/p][/*][*][p]Stem Cell Sprouter no longer requires Enzymes to build,[/p][/*][*][p]Stem Cell Sprouter's "benthos eater" production chain is off by default (i.e., when placing, no warnings appear if fertility is missing),[/p][/*][*][p]Spawning Stem Cells from Stem Cell Sprouter no longer costs mineral (just 1 protein),[/p][/*][*][p]DNA Sampler's "benthos eater" production chain is off by default,[/p][/*][*][p]Berrygrass' growth rate doubled,[/p][/*][*][p]Aminoberries' spawn time reduced (24 -> 20 seconds),[/p][/*][/list][h3]v0.2.6_demo patch notes:[/h3][list][*][p]Save system overhaul: Adding 48 manual save slots,[/p][/*][*][p]Grubbers now spawn work-ready,[/p][/*][*][p]Updated exploration tutorial with info text explaining:[/p][list][*][p]that Stem Cells should be fed on long journeys,[/p][/*][*][p]that Stem Cells get consumed by building plants and that this can be disabled,[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Hotfix:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed load button list misalignment in pause menu,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved explanations for strategic resources (in both tutorial 5 and main resource GUI)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Combat Update ⚔️
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="Aszt4TtvNKY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Peaceful base-building is over! Primordial Empire just got a Combat Update, featuring a [b]new combat scenario[/b] with new enemies and challenges. Muster your army of lancet cells and prepare your defence. Protect your colony of microbes from the relentless attacks of hostile organisms![/p][p][/p][h3]Update Highlights:[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/39c150c8f782614062205f579daf2a79fdf92453.png"][/img]Introducing the Hydra, a static turret with powerful projectiles. This defensive plant is slumbering somewhere on the combat scenario map. Explore every nook and cranny to retrieve it and bolster your defence.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/d0bf4bcdc033460f0681666cba3dba9f08217d9c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/b7c5049f876db0199ffa3bb6b0755678e74fce7f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/9c34be89364ec92caa3259ab19c83a839f946dca.png"][/img][/carousel][p]The enemies come with a well-equipped army of diverse units:[/p][list][*][p]Carnitubes - static structures (plants) hazardous to your wandering cells[/p][/*][*][p]Parasites and their Hives - "skirmishers" that harass and disrupt your colony[/p][/*][*][p]Stabpole - rank and file of the invaders. Attacks both cells and plants[/p][/*][*][p]Purgeling - a "siege unit" that can destroy plants with its devastating barrage[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]There are also a myriad of optimizations and fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Improved control: Attractive Pheromones diffuse "around corners" (i.e. can now call Cells that have no direct line of sight if a path is still relatively easy to find)[/p][/*][*][p]Grubber Burrows now don't cost any upkeep[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Lancet Hive mineral placement cost[/p][/*][*][p]Improved information about plants: what they see, what their reach is, etc. Plants like Grubber Burrows or Neurons show harvestable clusters/connections not only during build mode, but also when selecting existing plants. Same is true for Lumifloras' light cone.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed symbiotic feeding chain sometimes getting stuck not calling for Feeder Cells.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed radial menu tools disabling their control panel after repeated selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized several core functions, (e.g., wall collision resolving, drawing functions)[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: using combat warnings to jump to Carnitubes may crash the game[/p][/*][*][p]Improved recycle tool: More intuitive cell/plant selection behavior based on circle overlap with creatures. Improved clarity by highlighting selected creatures.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Outside of everything mentioned above, secrets lurk in the darkness of Primordial Empire. Can you find them?[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]And on that note, we shall conclude this patch notes. Feel free to let us know if you have any thoughts on the update or Primordial Empire as a whole. Every bit of feedback is crucial nutrition for our game to grow. Best of luck in your conquest of this microscopic world, and we look forward to bringing you more new content soon.[/p]

notes.title: May Monthly Round-Up 🦠
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! [/b]

Welcome back to Primordial Empire's monthly wrap-up, and this month we have some [i]exciting[/i] news. The demo launch gave everyone a taste of microscopic colony building, and we are very pleased to see so many colonies flourish in peace - but no peace lasts forever. It is time to raise the stakes, and our next update will introduce combat to the game.


[h2]Combat Update Incoming[/h2]
[previewyoutube=Aszt4TtvNKY;full][/previewyoutube]
Peaceful base-building will soon be over, as the combat update aims to bring enemies to your doorstep. In the new demo scenario, players will have to build an army of lancet cells to explore the hostile environment, and set up base defence using a new type of defensive plant to repel intruders. Check out our combat trailer for a first look at the new enemies, coming [b]this Friday June 6[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/8c38d29d3c55a545b3b32114040a3203721356fb.png[/img]
[i]Be careful, though. For a hungry menace lurks in the dark.[/i]


[h2]Developer Interview (German Language Content)[/h2]
https://youtu.be/DiyYzRj0FP4?si=p7qEKgrPmSYXhpcb
A couple weeks ago, Marc joined [url=https://www.twitch.tv/writing_bull]Writing Bull[/url] on stream to talk about the ins and outs of making Primordial Empire. For those of you who speaks German and are interested in an early preview of the combat in action, you can check out the VOD in which Marc played with the then work-in-progress scenario, with new challenges and objectives for players to conquer.


And on that note, we shall conclude this month's wrap up. Please look forward to the combat update to Primordial Empire's demo this Friday - Are you ready to take on the new threats and defend your colony?

notes.title: Our First Monthly Round-Up 🦠
notes.content:
[b]Greetings everyone! [/b]

Welcome to our first ever community monthly update. This will be a monthly summary of what Primordial Empire is up to every month, from events we participated in to sneak peeks of future content, so everyone can keep up with our latest news. Now without further ado, let’s hop right into the actual meat of this post, because there are a lot of great things to cover this month.

[h2]Demo launch, and Wishlist Milestone[/h2]
[previewyoutube=GWbRiaOSxzM;full][/previewyoutube]
Primordial Empire's demo was released last month, and we have been blown away by the overwhelming support from all of you. Within two weeks after the demo launch, we managed to hit 5000 wishlists. This is a major milestone for us and we got there way faster than expected. This couldn’t have happened without all of your help, and we’d like to thank you, our passionate community, for getting us there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/c40fcd7e4dba9b6bf2dc0af5b3d074e5ffbb3c21.png[/img]

[h2]Demo Update Patch[/h2]
A demo launch of many players comes with many pieces of feedback, and we have taken some time to release a patch to address some of the issues mentioned by our community. You can see the full patch log in this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3450780/view/564746584593531864]previous blog post[/url].

Primordial Empire is still a tiny colony, and we need every bit of resource available to grow. So please keep all the nutritious feedback coming - they are excellent nutrition for us to build up our microscopic empire, one cell at a time. 

[h2]YouTube Appearances[/h2]
Looks like Primoridial Empire’s demo release luckily got the attention of quite a few content creators, and our stem cells are making a bit of a ripple on social media. It’s a wonderful sight to see so many gamers excited about our indie colony sim. As a small indie game, we really appreciate them for putting in a good word for us on different platforms and showcasing the game to a wider audience. Here are some of the YouTube videos featuring Primordial Empire:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dr89g6B3EyI
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tn0tsAcPUOw 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p5XAU6M5RC8 
To all content creators, no matter which platform you are on, thank you for sharing Primordial Empire with your viewers and bringing the tiny cells to new audiences. On the side note, we also started [url=https://www.youtube.com/@PrimordialEmpire]our own YouTube channel[/url] - Subscribe and get the latest news of Primordial Empire!


[h2]Event Showcase[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/3529bf71a988be54b1e4e151077c9114595ff547.png[/img]
Speaking of showcasing, we also joined the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/EarthAppreciationFestival2025]Earth Appreciation Festival 2025[/url] and took part in the showcase video. We’re very excited to share our work along with so many promising and popular titles. You can see Marc, our solo developer of Primordial Empire, talking about the game in our segment here:
[previewyoutube=8QWzZBXWsdo;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]A Tiny Teaser…[/h2]
Seeing all the positive responses from all of you has filled our hearts with energizing plasma to work on future content. Before we go, let’s have a sneak peek at what might come next for Primordial Empire:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/96157d4fa56f3807c8a16e8492a31d8d371177b3.png[/img]
You might wonder what this is, and what it might do. Well, we can’t say too much for now, though you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/VpusSehk]Discord server[/url] and share your speculations with our community. Please look forward to future updates and we’ll see you in next month’s round-up.

notes.title: Demo Update Patch Notes - v0.1.4
notes.content:
Thank you every for a cracking demo launch and Earth Appreciation Festival! We are fast approaching 5,000 wishlists which is a great milestone in such a short amount of time (if you haven't wishlisted already please do!)

With the demo launch has come a great amount of feedback and we've made some changes to the demo which we have outlined below :)

As always, please keep the feedback coming in and we will continue updating the demo as development progresses!

[list]
[*] New Vesicle Hubs start with Plasma-powered chain input filled
[*] Mineral Extractor's Symbiotic Feeding chain defaults to high priority
[*] Can now set hunting behavior of Feeder Hubs and Carnivorous Protein Factory (allow/ban hunting Stem Cells / Aminoberries)
[*] Micro Agave now starts with 50 calories; food production never drains calories below 50 --> much more robust against starvation, using Symbiotic Feeding alone now more viable
[*] Poison damage now bursts cells if they are at very low health
[*] Bursting cells drop their resources
[*] Enzyme- and Toxin production is now more lenient if inputs are delayed (1.2 -> 1.5 times the production duration as a "grace period" before the strategic resource becomes unavailable). Robust logistical setup still required, but will work much more reliably now.
[*] Lancet Hive no longer costs Toxins to build, houses 4 Lancet Cells.
[*] Can now switch between full screen and borderless window mode
[*] Updated main menu logo and splash screen
[*] Several minor bugfixes, most importantly: save/load system is now more robust when loading older save files.
[/list]

This means you should be able to jump right back into your previous colony. If you encounter any issues/crashes, please notify me! Thanks and have fun 🙂

P.S.: There's a small teaser included in the update. Can you find it?

notes.title: Primordial Empire: Demo Available! 🦠
notes.content:
Greetings! I’m a Marc, the solo-developer of Primordial Empire, and welcome to this microscopic world of survival and evolution.

Primordial Empire is a side-on colony sim where players nurture and build an empire of microbes, plants and animals with a self-sustaining ecosystem. I’m thrilled to announced that the demo version of my game is now online, with a demo launch trailer and new [url=https://discord.gg/kanwBTWBZ5]Discord server[/url]!

[previewyoutube=TYNqoSrBUaY;full][/previewyoutube]
The demo offers 2 hours of gameplay, including a comprehensive tutorial that guides you through the core mechanics of Primordial Empire, and an open demo scenario for you to freely experiment with our 19 unique plants and 5 mobile cells, with more micro-organisms on the way! Explore your surroundings, gather resources and expand your Primordial Empire to every corner of this microscopic world!



Of course, more will be coming to the full game. Here’s a little screenshot teaser: Do you recognise what this peculiar plant is based on?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/9d62fd7b4768716f6ccd8f2fba846e942f942bff.png[/img]


For more details, here’s a road map with things you can look forward to! (You can find it on the Steam store page too)
[list]
[*] More creatures, more colors, more variety!
[*] World map with game progression: Build colonies in different biomes, each offering unique strategic resources. Complete goals in each colony to unlock new organisms and game mechanics, allowing for better colonies and more complex strategies.
[*] Trade: Establish resource-specialized colonies and later import those resources to cultivate increasingly powerful colonies.
[*] Colony defense: Protect your creations from invading organisms and spreading viruses. Trace threats back to their source and eliminate them.
[*] upgraded organisms to tackle new, more challenging goals.
[*] Semi-procedural biomes: Explore a large selection of hand-crafted terrains, dynamically populated with goodies and challenges, offering a fresh experience with every replay.
[/list]

If you like the demo, please give Primordial Empire a wishlist! And feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/kanwBTWBZ5]Discord[/url] and share any thoughts you have on my game! The game is still in development so I would really appreciate any feedback to improve this colony building experience! 


Enjoy the demo and see you in the primordial soup!
